mechanism_narrative: Accelerating GDP growth, as measured by the year-over-year change in real GDP, signals a strengthening economy that will boost corporate earnings and drive positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Y-o-y GDPC1 growth accelerates by > 2pp but SPX 60-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When the ISM manufacturing index (proxied by INDPRO) falls below 50 for two consecutive months, it signals a contraction in industrial activity that will lead to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO < 50 trigger activates but SPX 20-day forward returns are positive > 60% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate (> 0.5pp in one month) signals a rapidly weakening labor market that will pressure consumer spending and drive negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: UNRATE spike trigger activates but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (proxied by HOUST) rise by > 10% y-o-y while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 5%, it signals a strong consumer demand environment that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Trigger activates but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: A flattening of the yield curve, as measured by the spread between 10-year and 2-year Treasury yields, signals impending monetary tightening that will negatively impact S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Yield curve flattens by > 50 bps but SPX 60-day forward returns are positive > 55% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: Real retail sales (RSAFS) rising at a y-o-y rate of > 5% signals strong consumer demand that will boost S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days, especially in the early stages of an economic expansion.
failure_condition: RSAFS growth trigger activates but SPX 20-day forward returns are negative > 40% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: When payroll employment (PAYEMS) growth slows by > 1pp y-o-y while the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is rising, it signals a weakening labor market that will pressure S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS y-o-y growth slows by > 1pp AND UNRATE rising
failure_condition: Trigger activates but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.

mechanism_narrative: The S&P 500 tends to produce negative 5-day returns whenever the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is hiked by > 25 bps at an FOMC meeting, as it signals a more restrictive monetary policy stance.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises > 25 bps at FOMC meeting
failure_condition: FEDFUNDS hike trigger activates but SPX 5-day forward returns are positive > 50% of the time.
